usedFor: Gumlet hosts and optimizes video, and TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers when “Trigger Command” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Video Asset” in Gumlet, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new video asset can start a command on your own computer without anyone running it by hand.

watchOut: “New Video Asset” in Gumlet is polling and watches one collection, so “Trigger Command” runs after a scheduled check.
